verdict.rationale: Speakeasy documents an official gram CLI that covers each step of the story: it authenticates, stages OpenAPI documents and Functions for deployment, pushes and monitors deployments, and installs toolsets as MCP servers in AI agents. The evidence is a single first-party summary rather than detailed command-level documentation. Missing for 10: per-command reference detail in the evidence (e.g. a build step distinct from staging, supported agent install targets), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents

citations.quote: The gram CLI manages platform resources directly from the terminal. Use it to authenticate, stage OpenAPI documents and Functions for deployment, push and monitor deployments, install toolsets as MCP servers in AI agents
